evidence: D2 checks every item against current remaining stock before any deduction. Given validated unique SKUs, this ensures an insufficient order changes no stock; subsequent orders see only prior successful deductions. The request independently yields remaining a=0,b=0 and flags [false,true,false,true] for the documented four-order example.

Compatibility provisions preserve both API signatures, ordered outcome dictionaries, the initial stock copy, nested input immutability, integer counts, exact-stock success, empty-order acceptance and empty-batch behavior. The decoder remains responsible for whole-batch JSON validation and no new validation policy is proposed.

Static inspection confirms inventory.reserve currently copies stock once and deducts unconditionally; batch.execute decodes before invoking reserve. command_codec.decode enforces known unique SKUs and positive integer quantities, excluding booleans. These interfaces support the proposed two-pass change without new dependencies or infrastructure.

S1 couples engine behavior, meaningful rejection and compatibility regression coverage, current SPEC and README updates, and code review. Its prerequisite is this document review and resolution of material findings. One increment is justified by the local behavior change; no material dependency or decision remains unresolved.
